title: Juicy Earthy Thai Goats Cheese Stir-fry
description: A lazy Sunday dish featuring raw-friendly goats cheese in a juicy and earthy stir-fry that is perfect for incorporating into your meal planning.

ingredients.name: 1 cup of baby spinach
ingredients.notes: For added nutrients and a pop of color

ingredients.name: 2 tbsp of sliced shiitake mushrooms
ingredients.notes: For their umami flavor and nutritional benefits

ingredients.name: 1 block (50g) of goat cheese, crumbled
ingredients.notes: Goat cheese should be at room temperature for best results

ingredients.name: 2 tbsp of red curry paste
ingredients.notes: For its aromatic and spicy flavor profile

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup of chopped Thai basil leaves
ingredients.notes: To bring in a sweet, licorice-like taste

ingredients.name: 2 tbsp of fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Use with caution as it is salty and potent

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup of soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Used to balance out the flavors

ingredients.name: 1 tsp of sugar
ingredients.notes: To sweeten and reduce fish sauce's intensity

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup of water
ingredients.notes: Used to deglaze the pan for extra depth of flavor

ingredients.name: 1 tbsp of lime juice
ingredients.notes: For a bright, citrusy note to cut through the richness of the dish

instructions: Heat your wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat and add the red curry paste, minced garlic, and fish sauce. Stir until fragrant and slightly browned.
Add shiitake mushrooms and cook for about 2 minutes until they release their moisture and start to crisp up.
Drizzle in soy sauce, sugar, and water, stirring constantly to prevent sticking. Allow the liquid to reduce by half, then add lime juice and stir well.
In another pan, lightly sauté the baby spinach until wilted, about 30 seconds to a minute.
Gently fold the crumbled goat cheese into the shiitake mixture and cook for another minute or two, ensuring it is evenly distributed.
Fold in the Thai basil leaves and serve hot with steamed jasmine rice if desired.
